items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 9:56AM EDT until October 6 at 5:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt and seas 4 to 6 feet expected.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Cape Lookout to Surf City.

* WHEN...From 10 PM this evening to 5 PM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
